records.source: I wanted to give you this as a 'thank you' for letting me live here with you.$h
records.translation: Gusto kong ibigay ito bilang “pasasalamat” sa pagpapatira mo sa akin dito.$h

records.source: ...Have you encountered others like me, in the mines? I'm sorry if they were hostile towards you. You see, we've learned to fear humans... there have been too many... unpleasant encounters.#$e#You haven't... slain any of my friends, have you?
records.translation: ...May nakatagpo ka na bang tulad ko sa mga Minahan? Paumanhin kung naging marahas sila sa iyo. Alam mo, natutuhan naming matakot sa mga tao... napakarami nang... di-kaaya-ayang pagtatagpo.#$e#Hindi mo naman... pinatay ang alinman sa mga kaibigan ko, hindi ba?

records.source: Oh, a gift to remember the day that I hatched! Thank you!$h
records.translation: Ah, regalo upang alalahanin ang araw ng pagkapisa ko! Salamat!$h

records.source: The flow of water has been unusually strong today... what's going on up there?
records.translation: Kakaibang malakas ang agos ng tubig ngayon... ano ang nangyayari sa itaas?

records.source: Oh... is this what you call a 'birthday present'? I don't understand humans...$s
records.translation: Ah... ito ba ang tinatawag ninyong “regalo sa kaarawan”? Hindi ko nauunawaan ang mga tao...$s

records.source: Is that Stardrop Tea? Thank you! One drop makes my room smell good for the whole day.
records.translation: Tsaa ng Patak-Bituin ba iyan? Salamat! Napapabango ng isang patak ang silid ko sa buong araw.

records.source: Hey, look! All my friends are in here!$h#$b#Wait a minute, is that me...?$7
records.translation: Uy, tingnan mo! Narito ang lahat ng kaibigan ko!$h#$b#Sandali, ako ba iyon...?$7

records.source: A gift of lovely perfume? Oh, @... I'm blushing, but you probably can't notice...$4
records.translation: Regalo bang mabangong pabango? Ah, @... Namumula ako, pero malamang hindi mo iyon napapansin...$4

records.source: This smells delicious! I'll eat half, and use the other half to moisturize my body...$h
records.translation: Napakasarap ng amoy nito! Kakainin ko ang kalahati at gagamitin ang isa pang kalahati upang panatilihing mamasa-masa ang katawan ko...$h

records.source: A 1000 year war between my people and the dwarves recently ended. There's still a lot of resentment on both sides.
records.translation: Kamakailan lang natapos ang sanlibong taong digmaan sa pagitan ng mga kalahi ko at ng mga Duwende. Marami pa ring hinanakit sa magkabilang panig.

records.source: Please keep my location a secret. If the dwarves knew of me, they'd surely send an assassin.
records.translation: Pakiusap, ilihim mo ang kinaroroonan ko. Kung malaman ng mga Duwende ang tungkol sa akin, tiyak na magpapadala sila ng mamamatay-tao.

records.source: I try not to make too much noise down here. Imagine if the townspeople heard my weird sounds coming from the sewer drain...
records.translation: Sinisikap kong huwag gumawa ng masyadong ingay dito sa ibaba. Isipin mo kung marinig ng mga tagabayan ang kakaiba kong tunog mula sa lagusan ng imburnal...

records.source: ...I'm a little bruised, but I'm okay.
records.translation: ...Medyo may mga pasa ako, pero ayos lang.

records.source: Oh, it's an arctic shard! That's a very rare magical item.#$b#I'd bring that to the Wizard if I were you!
records.translation: Ah, Tipak ng Arktiko iyon! Napakabihirang mahiwagang bagay niyan.#$b#Kung ako sa iyo, dadalhin ko iyan sa Mago!

records.source: I find things here and I sell them. Care to buy anything?
records.translation: May mga bagay akong nahahanap dito at ibinebenta ko ang mga iyon. May gusto ka bang bilhin?

records.source: If you put your ear up to the right pipe, you can hear into any house from down here.#$b#I wouldn't eavesdrop, though!$3
records.translation: Kung ididikit mo ang tainga mo sa kanang tubo, maririnig mo mula rito ang loob ng anumang bahay.#$b#Pero hindi naman ako nakikinig nang palihim!$3

records.source: Please don't tell anyone about me.#$b#Humans tend to destroy things they can't understand.
records.translation: Pakiusap, huwag mong sabihin kaninuman ang tungkol sa akin.#$b#Madalas sirain ng mga tao ang mga bagay na hindi nila nauunawaan.

records.source: Please don't tell anyone about me.#$b#Most humans are frightened by us shadow people... maybe for good reason.$s#$b#But regardless, if the townspeople knew about me, I might not be safe here.
records.translation: Pakiusap, huwag mong sabihin kaninuman ang tungkol sa akin.#$b#Natatakot sa aming mga Taong-Anino ang karamihan sa mga tao... baka may mabuting dahilan.$s#$b#Gayunman, kung malaman ng mga tagabayan ang tungkol sa akin, baka hindi na ako ligtas dito.

records.source: I am too sensitive to sunlight to go out on most days.#$b#The conditions in here are perfect.#$e#Care to buy anything?
records.translation: Masyado akong sensitibo sa sikat ng araw upang lumabas sa karamihan ng mga araw.#$b#Perpekto ang kalagayan dito.#$e#May gusto ka bang bilhin?

records.source: Please, don't be alarmed. I am different than the others.#$e#I've spent a lot of time observing humans. I know you like to shop. Care to see my wares?
records.translation: Pakiusap, huwag kang mabahala. Naiiba ako sa iba.#$e#Matagal kong pinagmasdan ang mga tao. Alam kong mahilig kayong mamili. Gusto mo bang makita ang mga paninda ko?

records.source: Back again? I suppose it does fit into my theory of human behavior.
records.translation: Bumalik ka na naman? Sa palagay ko, tugma nga iyon sa teorya ko tungkol sa pag-uugali ng tao.

records.source: 'Krobus' means 'bridge-crosser' in our language.
records.translation: Ang “Krobus” ay nangangahulugang “tumatawid sa tulay” sa wika namin.

records.source: On Fridays I stay silent as a sign of devotion to Yoba.
records.translation: Tuwing Biyernes ay nananatili akong tahimik bilang tanda ng debosyon kay Yoba.

records.source: I'd love to see more of the outside world, but it wouldn't be safe for me.$s
records.translation: Gustong-gusto kong makakita pa ng mundo sa labas, pero hindi iyon ligtas para sa akin.$s

records.source: I'll never know what it's like to be human... but talking to you, I feel like I understand it a little.
records.translation: Hindi ko kailanman malalaman ang pakiramdam ng maging tao... pero kapag kausap kita, pakiramdam ko ay nauunawaan ko iyon nang kaunti.

records.source: ...Sorry, I'm still a little wary of humans. My shop is still open to you, however.
records.translation: ...Paumanhin, medyo maingat pa rin ako sa mga tao. Gayunman, bukas pa rin sa iyo ang tindahan ko.

records.source: You're not like the other humans, are you?
records.translation: Hindi ka tulad ng ibang tao, hindi ba?

records.source: You've opened my eyes to the world of humans. I appreciate that.
records.translation: Binuksan mo ang mga mata ko sa mundo ng mga tao. Nagpapasalamat ako roon.

records.source: The valley looks more interesting in the rain... don't you think?
records.translation: Mas kawili-wili ang lambak kapag umuulan... hindi ba?

records.source: The rain doesn't stop me from getting a job done!$h#$e#Although soggy wood isn't a joy to work with.$s
records.translation: Hindi ako napipigilan ng ulan na matapos ang trabaho!$h#$e#Pero hindi madaling magtrabaho gamit ang basang kahoy.$s

records.source: Greetings. Stay inside if you want to keep warm.
records.translation: Pagbati. Manatili ka sa loob kung gusto mong hindi malamigan.

records.source: When it rains I have a good excuse to work on my gadgets all day.$h#$e#It must be kind of boring for you, though.
records.translation: Kapag umuulan, may magandang dahilan akong magtrabaho sa mga aparato ko buong araw.$h#$e#Pero baka medyo nakakabagot iyon para sa iyo.

records.source: If you're lucky, you might see a frog in this weather.
records.translation: Kung suswertehin ka, baka makakita ka ng palaka sa ganitong panahon.

records.source: A warm rain is a pleasant way to get clean.$h
records.translation: Kaaya-ayang paraan ng paglilinis ang mainit na ulan.$h

records.source: Most people stay indoors on days like this... It's not good for business.$s
records.translation: Nananatili sa loob ang karamihan sa mga tao sa mga ganitong araw... Hindi iyon mabuti para sa negosyo.$s

records.source: My garden is happy today.$h#$e#...and our water bill will be lower this month.
records.translation: Masaya ang hardin ko ngayon.$h#$e#...at mas mababa ang bayarin namin sa tubig ngayong buwan.

records.source: Hmmph. This is not good weather for sports.$s#$e#Oh well, I can always lift weights inside.$h
records.translation: Hmph. Hindi magandang panahon ito para sa palakasan.$s#$e#Ayos lang, maaari naman akong mag-ehersisyo gamit ang mga dumbbell sa loob.$h

records.source: It's awful cold, isn't it? What a rotten day.
records.translation: Napakalamig, hindi ba? Napakasamang araw.

records.source: When I woke up I heard dripping from somewhere... I think the roof might be leaking.$s#$e#In the old days, George would've scampered right up and fixed it... *sigh*$s
records.translation: Nang magising ako, may narinig akong pagtulo mula sa kung saan... Sa tingin ko, baka may tagas ang bubong.$s#$e#Noong araw, mabilis na aakyat si George at aayusin iyon... *buntong-hininga*$s

records.source: Hi there, @. Taking a break?#$e#I hope the river doesn't overflow...$s
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Nagpapahinga ka?#$e#Sana hindi umapaw ang ilog...$s

records.source: Today would be a good day to explore the mines... Who knows, you might find some rare ores.
records.translation: Magandang araw ngayon upang galugarin ang mga Minahan... Malay mo, baka makahanap ka ng ilang bihirang mineral.

records.source: The raindrops are really loud on the metal roof of our trailer.#$e#...It's soothing, though.$h
records.translation: Napakalakas ng tunog ng mga patak ng ulan sa metal na bubong ng trailer namin.#$e#...Pero nakapagpapakalma iyon.$h

records.source: Howdy, kid. Stayin' dry?
records.translation: Kumusta, bata. Tuyo ka pa ba?

records.source: It never rains in Calico Desert... That's where my friend Sandy lives.#$e#I wish I could've visited her today.$s
records.translation: Hindi kailanman umuulan sa Disyerto ng Calico... Doon nakatira ang kaibigan kong si Sandy.#$e#Sana nadalaw ko siya ngayon.$s

records.source: I spent all morning doing my hair... now the rain could mess it up.$s#$e#*sigh* ... Life is hard sometimes.
records.translation: Buong umaga kong inayos ang buhok ko... baka sirain iyon ng ulan.$s#$e#*buntong-hininga*... Mahirap talaga ang buhay kung minsan.

records.source: Did you wipe your boots off before coming in? Sorry... I just cleaned the floor.#$e#But you're always welcome in here! Heh.$h
records.translation: Pinunasan mo ba ang mga bota mo bago pumasok? Paumanhin... Kalilinis ko lang ng sahig.#$e#Pero palagi kang malugod na tinatanggap dito! Heh.$h

records.source: Rain muffles sound, so I can play my guitar louder without my mom getting mad. Hehe.$h
records.translation: Pinahihina ng ulan ang tunog, kaya maaari kong lakasan ang pagtugtog ng gitara nang hindi nagagalit si Mama. Hehe.$h

records.source: Maybe I should cook something new and exciting today. Something spicy.
records.translation: Baka dapat akong magluto ng bago at kapana-panabik ngayon. Isang bagay na maanghang.

records.source: Hmm... this weather makes me thirsty.$s
records.translation: Hmm... Nauuhaw ako sa panahong ito.$s

records.source: Hi @. You look like you're soaked...you poor thing!$h
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Mukhang basang-basa ka... kawawa ka naman!$h

records.source: Sometimes when I lay in bed I can hear a distant foghorn cut through the rain.#$b#But when I look out the window I see only a curtain of gray.
records.translation: Minsan, kapag nakahiga ako sa kama, naririnig kong tinatagos ng malayong busina sa hamog ang ulan.#$b#Pero kapag dumudungaw ako sa bintana, tabing na kulay-abo lamang ang nakikita ko.

records.source: There's nothing like a glass of dry red wine on a day like this, huh?#$e#I love my job. Hehehe.
records.translation: Walang tatalo sa isang baso ng tuyong pulang alak sa ganitong araw, ano?#$e#Gustong-gusto ko ang trabaho ko. Hehehe.

records.source: Rain... It's almost mythical to us. Some of us dwarves live our entire lives without ever experiencing it.
records.translation: Ulan... Halos alamat iyon para sa amin. May ilang Duwendeng nabubuhay nang buong buhay nila nang hindi iyon nararanasan.

records.source: Stormy days are the only time I can commune with certain elementals.#$e#I don't expect you to understand.
records.translation: Sa mga araw lang na may bagyo ako maaaring makipag-ugnayan sa ilang Elemental.#$e#Hindi ko inaasahang mauunawaan mo.

records.source: Hi @! Er... Read anything interesting in the library lately?#$e#Heh. Well, um... I'll see you around then?
records.translation: Kumusta, @! Ah... May nabasa ka bang kawili-wili sa aklatan kamakailan?#$e#Heh. Aba, ah... magkikita na lang tayo ulit?

records.source: I heard it's raining back home. Is that why you came here?$h#$e#I kind of miss the rain, actually...$s
records.translation: Narinig kong umuulan sa inyo. Iyon ba ang dahilan kung bakit ka pumunta rito?$h#$e#Sa totoo lang, medyo hinahanap-hanap ko rin ang ulan...$s

records.source: Ah, the sewers are flowing quickly today. It'll get nice and humid in here... Just how I like it.
records.translation: Ah, mabilis ang agos sa mga imburnal ngayon. Magiging kaaya-ayang mahalumigmig dito... Gustong-gusto ko iyon.

records.source: The valley is peaceful when it rains.#$e#To me... nature is someone I know, with different moods.
records.translation: Payapa ang lambak kapag umuulan.#$e#Para sa akin... parang kakilala ko ang kalikasan na may iba’t ibang damdamin.
